text:
maria_releng: deploybot just flagged a p95 regression in canary (eu-west-1). Autorevert threshold hit. Can we hold auto-rollback for a quick hotfix?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary p95 latency > 1.8s (threshold 1.5s). Autorevert in 2m unless manual override applied. details: https://ci/reports/1729995

kev_oncall: oncall here — what's the suspected root cause? any 500s or just latency?

elaine_dev: seeing increased tail on model-serving workers, no 5xx spike. traces show KV cache misses on long sequences. Might be a bad quantization fallback hitting new kernel.

sam_ops: we have a tiny window to patch config. If we hold autorevert we need an explicit operator ack (to avoid accidental customer impact). Recommend pin traffic and roll a small config revert.

maria_releng: Agree. I'll request manual hold. @kev_oncall can you hold autorevert for 15m? I'll coordinate release note and customer comms.

kev_oncall: Holding autorevert now. `deploybot override --thread 1729995000 --hold 900 --reason \"investigate kv cache regression\"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by kev_oncall for 900s. Manual revert still allowed.

elaine_dev: thanks. I'm preparing a fast rollback of the kernel flag patch. Plan: revert patch A123 on canary -> smoke -> promote. Command: ```git revert --no-commit A123 && ./infra/deploy --env canary --tag v3.4.1-rollback-flag```

sam_ops: If that fails, we should pin model-version for affected route to previous stable to avoid cascade. Pin command (if needed): `rctrl pin-route --route /generate --model redwood-v3.4-stable`

maria_releng: I'll also draft a short release-note blurb and CSM note. Copy suggestion: \"Canary observed increased tail latency due to kernel fallback on long sequences. We've held the autorevert and are reverting the kernel flag; will monitor and update.\" Thoughts?

kev_oncall: fine. Add estimated ETA: 20m for revert + 5m monitoring. Call out any customer-facing impact: none expected for prod, only canary.

elaine_dev: revert applied to canary at 1729995075. smoke tests running. logs: ```smoke: ok; p95 now 1.2s; no 5xx```

maria_releng: perfect — I'll update release notes and send a short CSM note: \"Canary patch reverted; no customer impact observed. We will promote fixed build after verification.\"

sam_ops: once you promote, I'll disable the hold so deploybot can resume normal policy. Remember to include changelog entry pointing to the reverted PR.

maria_releng: promoted to canary green at 1729995120. Removing hold now.

kev_oncall: `deploybot override --thread 1729995000 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by kev_oncall. Normal autorevert policy restored.

maria_releng: closing loop — release-note blurb and PR links posted in #release-notes. Will draft a short postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:

elaine_dev: filing a follow-up issue to add a safety gate for kernel fallback + add more kv-cache telemetry.

sam_ops: thanks everyone. short and tidy.
